newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber dips on weaker Thai offer prices.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber dips on weaker Thai offer prices.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Tuesday, as weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan pressured the market, traders said.
The newly listed benchmark July contract ended at 142.1 yen per kg after opening at 143.7 yen. Other prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 1.4 yen per kg lower.

In the continued bearish sentiment, the market failed to gain on the yen's further weakness against the dollar and a fall in Japan's rubber stocks as of January 20. "The market's failure to react to bullish factors suggests that speculative interest in rubber futures is thin," one trader said.
